snippet.title: Wild Life Game - New Cinematic Trailer + Release Date
snippet.description:
Wishlist Wild Life on Steam: (cant post the steam link to youtube since its an Adult game)


ABOUT THE CINEMATIC TRAILER

• No generative AI was used in this trailer or in Wild Life.
• Everything you see was handcrafted by our team. 
• Most shots were created directly inside our Unreal Engine 5 project.
• The trailer uses the same characters, environments and assets developed for the game.
• Camera work, lighting, animation, scene composition and editing were created by our team.

ABOUT WILD LIFE

Wild Life is a story-driven open-world action RPG set on the dangerous world of Kerpal. Play as Max and Maya, explore a vast handcrafted world, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries and master a souls inspired combat system.

• Open-world action RPG set on the planet Kerpal
• Play as Max and Maya
• Exploration, story, quests and real-time combat
• Steam release: February 8, 2027
• Price: $40
• No Early Access
• No pre-orders
• No battle passes or microtransactions
• No post-release monetization
• NO DRM

DEVELOPMENT

• All assets, animations, systems, Blueprints and trailers are created in-house.
• Feature and content complete target: October 1, 2026
• After content completion, we enter our dedicated polishing and optimization phase.
• Full gameplay trailer planned for early December 2026.
• Public development updates every Friday on Steam, X and Patreon.

THE SANDBOX

The Sandbox is a separate creative mode for building custom maps, customizing characters and creating interactive scenes and experiences.

• Developed throughout our Patreon journey alongside our community
• Development continues on Patreon after the main game's release
• Tons of fan-service and extra content beyond the world of Wild Life
• Releases later in 2027 as FREE DLC for everyone who owns Wild Life


We poured a huge amount of effort into this trailer, and we truly hope you enjoy watching it.

Voice Actors:
Max: P.M Seymour 
Maya: TemptyVA 
#WildLife #UnrealEngine5 #indiegame 

Thank you to everyone following the final stages of development. ❤️
